newsitem.title: GREECE: Athens bourse extends Magrizos trade halt.
newsitem.headline: Athens bourse extends Magrizos trade halt.

text.p: The Athens bourse has extended its trading halt on common and preferred shares of textiles firm Magrizos, it said in a statement. No further details were given.

Shares of Magrizos have been linked to the Delta Securities settlement scandal which is under investigation. Some SMEHA members have expressed suspicion about trades in the shares in textile firms Magrizos, Mills St. George and Parnassos.

The statement made no mention of three other shares which were banned from trading for two days last week -- Parnassos, Hellenic Sugar Industry and St George Mills -- but they appeared to be trading normally.
The bourse said last week that the suspensions were not related to the companies or economic situations, but to allow checks to be conducted on transactions in the shares.

The president of the Association of Athens Stock Exchange Members (SMEHA), Panagiotis Kondalexis, is due to meet national economy minister Yannos Papandoniou on Monday over articles in a draft bill introducing new measures on the exchange. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
